tables.name: user

fields.name: id
fields.comments: UUIDv7.

fields.name: name
fields.comments: Display name.

fields.name: email
fields.comments: Sign-in email, stored lowercased.

fields.name: email_verified
fields.comments: Boolean.

fields.name: image
fields.comments: Avatar URL.

fields.name: created_at
fields.comments: Epoch ms, UTC.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.comments: Epoch ms, UTC.

tables.comments: Better Auth user. One row per human, shared across organizations.

tables.name: session

fields.name: user_id
fields.comments: ON DELETE CASCADE.

fields.name: token
fields.comments: Session token held in the cookie.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.comments: Epoch ms, UTC.

fields.name: active_organization_id
fields.comments: Organization plugin. The tenant every query in this session is scoped to. ON DELETE SET NULL.

fields.name: active_team_id
fields.comments: Organization plugin with teams. Optional filter, not an access boundary. ON DELETE SET NULL.

tables.comments: Better Auth session. Carries the active organization and team, which every server function reads to scope its queries.

tables.name: account

fields.name: user_id
fields.comments: ON DELETE CASCADE.

fields.name: account_id
fields.comments: Identifier at the provider; equals user_id for the credential provider.

fields.name: provider_id
fields.comments: credential, or an OAuth provider id.

fields.name: password
fields.comments: Password hash, credential provider only.

tables.comments: Better Auth credential or linked provider. Email/password sign-in stores the password hash here.

tables.name: passkey

fields.name: name
fields.comments: Label the user gave it.

fields.name: public_key
fields.comments: COSE public key, base64.

fields.name: user_id
fields.comments: ON DELETE CASCADE.

fields.name: credential_id
fields.comments: WebAuthn credential id, base64url.

fields.name: counter
fields.comments: Signature counter, checked against replayed assertions.

fields.name: device_type
fields.comments: singleDevice or multiDevice.

fields.name: backed_up
fields.comments: Boolean. Synced by the platform, e.g. iCloud Keychain.

fields.name: transports
fields.comments: Comma-separated, e.g. internal,hybrid.

fields.name: created_at
fields.comments: Epoch ms, UTC.

fields.name: aaguid
fields.comments: Authenticator model id.

tables.comments: Passkey plugin (@better-auth/passkey). A WebAuthn credential a signed-in user registered; sign-in looks it up by credential_id.

tables.name: verification

fields.name: identifier
fields.comments: What the value verifies, e.g. an email address.

tables.comments: Better Auth one-time values: email verification, password reset.

tables.name: organization

fields.name: slug
fields.comments: URL-safe handle.

fields.name: metadata
fields.comments: Plugin-defined JSON. Not used by the app.

tables.comments: Tenant. Every app-owned table carries organization_id and every query filters by it.

tables.name: member

fields.name: organization_id
fields.comments: ON DELETE CASCADE.

fields.name: user_id
fields.comments: ON DELETE CASCADE.

fields.name: role
fields.comments: owner, admin, member (plugin defaults). No CHECK: the plugin can store several roles comma-separated.

tables.comments: A user in an organization. A user can be a member of several organizations.

tables.name: team

fields.name: organization_id
fields.comments: ON DELETE CASCADE.

fields.name: member_count
fields.comments: Maintained by Better Auth when members join or leave.

indexes.name: team_id_organization_id_idx
indexes.comments: Target of composite foreign keys, so rows pointing at a team cannot name another organization.

tables.comments: A group of members within an organization. Groups people for access and reporting; it owns no data.

tables.name: team_member

fields.name: team_id
fields.comments: ON DELETE CASCADE.

fields.name: user_id
fields.comments: ON DELETE CASCADE.

fields.name: role
fields.comments: App-managed. CHECK: lead, member. A lead reads and reports on the time of the team. Better Auth 1.7 has no additional fields on team members, so it never reads or writes this column; new rows get the default.

fields.name: membership_key
fields.comments: Better Auth dedupe key, SHA-256 of team_id and user_id.

tables.comments: A user in a team. A member can be in several teams of the same organization.

tables.name: invitation

fields.name: organization_id
fields.comments: ON DELETE CASCADE.

fields.name: email
fields.comments: Invitee address, lowercased.

fields.name: role
fields.comments: Organization role granted on acceptance.

fields.name: team_id
fields.comments: Team joined on acceptance, if any. ON DELETE SET NULL.

fields.name: status
fields.comments: pending, accepted, rejected, canceled.

fields.name: inviter_id
fields.comments: ON DELETE CASCADE.

tables.comments: Pending invitation to an organization, optionally into a team.

tables.name: user_settings

fields.name: time_zone
fields.comments: IANA zone, e.g. Europe/Tallinn. Drives display and report day/week boundaries.

fields.name: week_start
fields.comments: CHECK: mon, sun.

fields.name: created_at
fields.comments: Audit. Epoch ms, set by the database.

fields.name: created_by
fields.comments: Audit. Acting user, set by the app per request.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.comments: Audit. Set by the app on update; trigger fallback.

fields.name: updated_by
fields.comments: Audit. Acting user of the last change, set by the app.

fields.name: locale
fields.comments: UI language: en, et. Set from the browser on first sign-in; validated in the app, no CHECK.

fields.name: theme
fields.comments: system, light, dark. The server renders the theme class from it. Validated in the app, no CHECK.

fields.name: timer_layout
fields.comments: bar, focus, table. Validated in the app, no CHECK.

fields.name: show_summary
fields.comments: Boolean 0/1 (CHECK). Whether the timer page shows the summary.

fields.name: compact_rows
fields.comments: Boolean 0/1 (CHECK), default 0. Whether the timer shows entry rows compact.

fields.name: app_icon
fields.comments: Brand concept 01 to 12 (src/lib/app-icon.ts), default 02. Header mark and favicon. Validated in the app, no CHECK.

fields.name: scene_season
fields.comments: auto (by month), winter, spring, summer, autumn. The scene, weather, and tagline. Validated in the app, no CHECK.

fields.name: scene_background
fields.comments: Boolean 0/1 (CHECK). Whether the season image shows behind the pages.

fields.name: scene_strength
fields.comments: dimmed, full: how much page color covers the image. Validated in the app, no CHECK.

fields.name: surfaces
fields.comments: glass, solid: whether cards let the image show through. Validated in the app, no CHECK.

fields.name: scene_weather
fields.comments: Boolean 0/1 (CHECK). Whether the season weather effect runs.

fields.name: scene_intro
fields.comments: Boolean 0/1 (CHECK). Whether the intro plays on first visit and once a season.

tables.comments: Per-user settings, one row per user, shared across organizations and devices. Created on first sign-in with the time zone and language of the browser. Lives as long as the user, so no sys_deleted.

tables.name: project

fields.name: id
fields.comments: UUIDv7, generated on the client.

fields.name: color
fields.comments: Hex color for the UI, e.g. #4E79A7.

fields.name: archived_at
fields.comments: Epoch ms. Domain lifecycle, not deletion: archived projects take no new entries but stay in history and reports.

fields.name: created_at
fields.comments: Audit. Epoch ms, set by the database.

fields.name: created_by
fields.comments: Audit. Acting user, set by the app per request.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.comments: Audit. Set by the app on update; trigger fallback.

fields.name: updated_by
fields.comments: Audit. Acting user of the last change, set by the app.

fields.name: sys_deleted
fields.comments: Audit. Logical delete, CHECK 0 or 1. Deleted rows are excluded everywhere, reports included.

indexes.name: project_organization_id_name_idx
indexes.comments: Partial: WHERE sys_deleted = 0. A deleted project frees its name.

indexes.name: project_id_organization_id_idx
indexes.comments: Target of composite foreign keys, so rows pointing at a project cannot name another organization.

tables.comments: Owned by the organization. Visible to the whole organization unless assigned to teams.

tables.name: project_team

fields.name: project_id
fields.comments: Composite FK (project_id, organization_id) to project (id, organization_id).

fields.name: team_id
fields.comments: Deleting a team (Better Auth deletes rows) drops its assignments. Composite FK (team_id, organization_id) to team (id, organization_id). ON DELETE CASCADE.

fields.name: organization_id
fields.comments: Tenant key. The composite foreign keys to project and team make it equal the organization of both.

fields.name: created_at
fields.comments: Audit. Epoch ms, set by the database.

fields.name: created_by
fields.comments: Audit. Acting user, set by the app per request.

tables.comments: Assigns a project to a team. A project with no rows here is available to everyone in the organization. Rows are inserted and deleted, never updated, so only created_* audit columns.

tables.name: time_entry

fields.name: id
fields.comments: UUIDv7, generated on the client so optimistic updates keep a stable key.

fields.name: user_id
fields.comments: Whose time this is. May differ from created_by when an admin adds an entry for someone.

fields.name: project_id
fields.comments: Optional. Keeps the entry in the organization of its project. Composite FK (project_id, organization_id) to project (id, organization_id).

fields.name: description
fields.comments: What was worked on.

fields.name: started_at
fields.comments: Epoch ms, UTC.

fields.name: stopped_at
fields.comments: Epoch ms, UTC. CHECK stopped_at > started_at. Null while running.

fields.name: created_at
fields.comments: Audit. Epoch ms, set by the database.

fields.name: created_by
fields.comments: Audit. Acting user, set by the app per request.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.comments: Audit. Set by the app on update; trigger fallback.

fields.name: updated_by
fields.comments: Audit. Acting user of the last change, set by the app.

fields.name: sys_deleted
fields.comments: Audit. Logical delete, CHECK 0 or 1. Deleted rows are excluded everywhere, reports included.

indexes.name: time_entry_user_id_idx
indexes.comments: Partial: WHERE stopped_at IS NULL AND sys_deleted = 0. At most one running timer per user across all organizations.

indexes.name: time_entry_organization_id_user_id_started_at_idx
indexes.comments: Own entry list and per-member reports.

tables.comments: A span of tracked time. A row with stopped_at null is the running timer; elapsed time is computed on the client and never written periodically.
